notes.title: 0.95 is here with NEW TREES!
notes.content:
Hi, treelovers! We really love your unselfish passion for [b]Nature[/b], so we put some more content in [b]YouAreTre[/b]. Enjoy!
[list]
[*][b]New Trees[/b] to Play! Finally! And many more to come soon with future new Biom Updates, so stick around!
[*]Added few [b]new random events[/b] (all we can say - there's birds in there now ;)
[*]Classic lights/shadows [b]performance improvements[/b]
[/list]
See you all outside! Bye!

notes.title: Monthly Update 3 is here!
notes.content:
- Animal events FINALLY
- New little easter for Oppenheimer movie

notes.title: Patch 0.93 is Here!
notes.content:
- Added new events (very rare, but not a problem to witness by a real tree)
- Sound fixes (looping of some BG sounds was broken)
- Performance minor improvements

notes.title: RELEASE IS HERE!
notes.content:
Finally, "You Are Tre" is available to everyone around the world! Now anyone can experience TRUE tree life sitting at home and without any reason to go out. 
Well Growth to everyone! And thanks for your support! This is just a start.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE
notes.content: Happy to announce that EA release will happen at 12.05.2023 with a max discount -40%. Feels right to encourage early customers)
